title: Semi-integrable almost hyperhermitian structures
summary: In this work, we introduce a family of almost hyperhermitian structures that we call semi-integrable. We subdivide them into four disjoint classes and show that each class is non-empty. Finally, we construct semi-integrable almost hyperhermitian structures on all reductive Lie algebras of compact type and dimension $4n$, with $n\geq 2$.
